plain.description: An unhurried little wanderer who can make an afternoon out of finding a particularly good pebble. Keeps it for a bit, then puts it back.
plain.likes: warm doorsteps and pebbles that fit just right.
plain.hates: being hurried when there is still plenty of afternoon.
plain.hobbies: Taking the long way around a very small patch of grass.

fire.description: A tiny enthusiast with a flame-shaped cap and an urgent need to get the evening gathering started. Has already saved everyone a spot.
fire.likes: cosy circles and stories with a good beginning.
fire.hates: cold snacks on chilly evenings and gatherings ending too soon.
fire.hobbies: Arranging seats in a circle, then squeezing in one more.

water.description: Under that droplet hood is a dedicated puddle inspector. No puddle is too small for a second visit, especially after a bit of rain.
water.likes: ripples and the hollow plink of a falling drop.
water.hates: soggy sleeves and puddles that vanish before a visit.
water.hobbies: Counting rings on puddles until the rings overlap.

snow.description: Bundled up to the very last scarf end, this kid treats a chilly day as permission to take everything slowly. Even the snack breaks.
snow.likes: thick scarves and the hush of a fresh snowfall.
snow.hates: slushy paths and a scarf tucked in too tightly.
snow.hobbies: Leaving a short trail of footprints, then admiring the spacing.

wind.description: A scarf-wearing rambler who always takes the breeziest path. Stops often to check whether the scarf has discovered a new direction.
wind.likes: billowing laundry and a clear stretch of path.
wind.hates: sticky knots and rooms with no open window.
wind.hobbies: Following drifting leaves without ever asking where they are going.

stone.description: Steady as the slab perched overhead, this kid is an excellent keeper of places. Will wait beside a chosen spot all afternoon.
stone.likes: cool shade and things that stay where they are put.
stone.hobbies: Sorting pebbles by how comfortably they sit on the ground.

chef.description: The tall hat means snack time is being taken seriously. This kid sets out a tiny tasting spoon, then takes notes on the napkin.
chef.likes: little spoons and a neatly folded napkin.
chef.hates: a missing spoon and crumbs in the notes.
chef.hobbies: Drawing a grand menu for one very small afternoon snack.

firefighter.description: A helmeted helper with a fondness for being ready early. Packs for a short outing as though it might include three snack stops.
firefighter.likes: tidy coils and knowing where everything is.
firefighter.hates: sticky handles and a bag that will not close.
firefighter.hobbies: Rolling up the hose neatly, then checking the loop one last time.

snowman.description: Wears a top hat to even the smallest occasion. Once declared a quiet patch of shade an occasion and stayed there until teatime.
snowman.likes: cool afternoons and invitations on thick paper.
snowman.hates: dripping hat brims and puddles beneath the best seat.
snowman.hobbies: Making up polite greetings for visitors who have not arrived yet.

steam.description: A dreamy little drifter with a curling tuft overhead. Gets sidetracked watching wisps rise and calls this a very productive morning.
steam.likes: warm windows and slowly curling wisps.
steam.hates: dry crumbs and being asked to hurry up a daydream.
steam.hobbies: Tracing loose spirals in a notebook without lifting the pencil.

sprout.description: Very proud of the little shoot overhead, but far too busy checking the ground to boast. Has noticed a new speck of green today.
sprout.hates: heavy lids and labels bigger than their pots.
sprout.hobbies: Measuring tiny shoots with a twig and keeping very tiny records.

sail.description: That little sail is always ready for an outing. This kid gives every puddle a grand name, even the one beside the doorstep.
sail.likes: striped cloth and the gentle bob of a floating leaf.
sail.hates: droopy fabric and outings with no snack stop.
sail.hobbies: Launching leaf boats and recording their extremely short voyages.

blizzard.description: A brisk little stroller with a snowflake cap and a scarf that rarely stays tucked. Calls every lap around the garden an expedition.
blizzard.likes: crisp mornings and a scarf end flapping behind.
blizzard.hates: sticky mittens and indoor afternoons that last too long.
blizzard.hobbies: Drawing maps of the best routes through fresh snow.

builder.description: Measures twice, sets down the tool, then measures once more for luck. A small stack of blocks deserves a proper plan.
builder.likes: straight edges and blocks that line up neatly.
builder.hates: rolling supplies and a ruler borrowed without asking.
builder.hobbies: Making tiny benches and checking each one for wobble.

forge.description: With an anvil cap and a stout apron, this kid has a soft spot for solid things. Taps each finished trinket to hear its little note.
forge.likes: sturdy shapes and a satisfying little clink.
forge.hates: rattly drawers and things that roll off the workbench.
forge.hobbies: Laying out a collection of tiny metal bells from low note to high.

kite.description: A patient keeper of strings, with a little diamond kite perched overhead. Untangles a knot as though it were an interesting puzzle.
kite.likes: long ribbons and just the right tug on a string.
kite.hates: wet paper and knots pulled tight in a hurry.
kite.hobbies: Drawing looping routes for a kite that prefers its own route.

hero.description: A cape makes even a small errand feel grand. This kid proudly volunteers to fetch the forgotten napkin, then brings a spare.
hero.likes: helpful errands and a cape with a good swish.
hero.hates: being left out of a task that needs one more helper.
hero.hobbies: Inventing important titles for ordinary acts of kindness.

sundae.description: The scoop cap is fancy; the plans are simple. This kid knows the nicest shaded seats and is happy to spend all day trying them.
sundae.likes: little umbrellas and the shady end of a bench.
sundae.hates: drips on the best seat and a missing snack spoon.
sundae.hobbies: Rating shady spots on a scale from lovely to especially lovely.

gardener.description: Carries a watering can and remembers every pot's usual spot. Says good morning to the seedlings before checking the day's list.
gardener.likes: well-used tools and a row of neatly labelled pots.
gardener.hates: crunchy bits in soft soil and labels facing the wall.
gardener.hobbies: Sketching new leaf shapes in the margins of the watering list.

raincloud.description: A small cloud follows this kid's wandering pace. Always offers the driest place to a visitor, even if it is only half a doorstep.
raincloud.likes: window seats and the patter on a broad leaf.
raincloud.hates: splashy shortcuts and damp notebook corners.
raincloud.hobbies: Keeping a list of all the different sounds a drizzle can make.

glassblower.description: Goggles pushed up, this kid pauses to inspect every little glass bubble. The slightly lopsided ones get the best shelf.
glassblower.likes: clear colours and a bubble with an interesting wobble.
glassblower.hates: cloudy glass and shelves too crowded for a new treasure.
glassblower.hobbies: Drawing possible shapes for a collection of tiny glass vases.

baker.description: Carries a bread paddle like a very important tray. Leaves a little space in every basket in case someone arrives late.
baker.likes: warm baskets and floury notes pinned up neatly.
baker.hates: hard lumps and someone taking the last basket.
baker.hobbies: Drawing new bread shapes, including one shaped like a slipper.

tea.description: A quiet host carrying a cup and a rather small tea bag. Thinks the nicest part of a visit is the comfortable pause between stories.
tea.likes: slow afternoons and a cup on its own little saucer.
tea.hates: rushed visits and loud clattering during a quiet pause.
tea.hobbies: Choosing a different spot for the afternoon cup each day.

cocoa.description: The mug apron makes this kid easy to spot at a cosy gathering. Carefully counts out enough cushions, then adds one just in case.
cocoa.likes: soft cushions and sleeves pulled over the nubs.
cocoa.hates: sharp tangs and a seat beside a draughty crack.
cocoa.hobbies: Designing the perfect snug corner on a scrap of paper.

flower.description: Wears a little blossom as though every day were a special visit. Leaves pressed petals between pages, then forgets which pages.
flower.likes: pretty paper and unexpected splashes of colour.
flower.hates: bent page corners and petals swept up too soon.
flower.hobbies: Making bookmarks that are almost too small to find again.

cactus.description: A little cactus crown, a snug pot band and a firm sense of personal space. Excellent company for a pleasantly quiet afternoon.
cactus.likes: sunny corners and visitors who ask before borrowing.
cactus.hobbies: Moving one pebble at a time until the sunny corner feels just right.

mushroom.description: A low cap suits this kid's preference for low-key outings. Finds the most interesting specks of moss just beside the main path.
mushroom.likes: mossy edges and the underside of a broad leaf.
mushroom.hates: bright midday glare and paths with no shady detours.
mushroom.hobbies: Making a miniature map of the dampest, quietest garden corners.

potter.description: Carries a little clay pot with great care. Every cup in this kid's collection leans a different way, and each has its own shelf spot.
potter.likes: soft clay and useful things with uneven edges.
potter.hates: dry crumbs in the clay and perfectly identical cups.
potter.hobbies: Pinching tiny bowls and finding a purpose for every wonky one.

crystal.description: That jagged crown catches the light, which is reason enough to stop walking. This kid can spend ages finding the best angle.
crystal.likes: crisp edges and a fleck of light on the wall.
crystal.hates: sticky smudges and a good sparkle hidden by clutter.
crystal.hobbies: Sorting shiny pebbles by which patch of daylight suits them.

blacksmith.description: A small hammer and apron accompany a very particular craftsperson. Makes hooks for everyone, including a hook for spare hooks.
blacksmith.likes: square tool handles and a tidy row of hooks.
blacksmith.hates: stained work notes and tools returned to the wrong peg.
blacksmith.hobbies: Sketching new handles for tools that already have perfectly good handles.

lighthouse.description: With a little lamp cap and striped band, this kid has a knack for marking the way. Even a trip to the next bench gets directions.
lighthouse.likes: clear evening views and a well-marked turning.
lighthouse.hates: murky windows and a sign facing the wrong way.
lighthouse.hobbies: Drawing helpful arrows on maps of very familiar places.

captain.description: The jaunty cap is ready, the little wheel is steady, and the day's route is planned. There is an impressive number of pauses on it.
captain.likes: folded maps and a clear place to stop for a snack.
captain.hates: spilled drinks on maps and routes with no margin for a rest.
captain.hobbies: Naming imaginary bays after the shapes of nearby pebbles.

whistle.description: A little whistle badge suits a kid who likes a clear cue. Rehearses the start of a parade even when the parade is just one lap.
whistle.likes: short tunes and everyone starting together.
whistle.hates: sticky whistles and a count-in nobody can hear.
whistle.hobbies: Tapping out a marching rhythm for a row of wooden buttons.

pinwheel.description: Carries a pinwheel and considers every pause a chance to test the breeze. Has a whole notebook devoted to almost-spins.
pinwheel.likes: bright paper and a breeze arriving at just the right moment.
pinwheel.hates: bent paper tips and sitting where the air never moves.
pinwheel.hobbies: Counting turns, losing count, and cheerfully starting over.

lantern.description: A little lamp cap and star badge belong to a careful evening host. Checks that every visitor has a lit path all the way home.
lantern.likes: warm pools of light and unhurried goodbyes.
lantern.hates: long crunchy interruptions in the middle of a bedtime story.
lantern.hobbies: Making a list of the cosiest reading spots after dusk.

picnic.description: The paper cap is folded and the basket is packed. This kid spends more time choosing a blanket spot than anyone spends on lunch.
picnic.likes: checked blankets and a patch of dry, level grass.
picnic.hates: tipped mugs and a blanket corner that keeps folding under.
picnic.hobbies: Packing a basket in different orders until everything fits snugly.

greenhouse.description: Under a little glass roof, this kid keeps a careful pot diary. A new leaf earns a whole page, even when the leaf is barely a speck.
greenhouse.likes: bright windows and a neat date at the top of a page.
greenhouse.hates: sour smells in a cosy nook and windows smeared with fingerprints.
greenhouse.hobbies: Turning pots a little at a time so every side gets its afternoon light.

bouquet.description: Carries a small bunch of blossoms and a large supply of gift ideas. Tucks a posy beside an ordinary note to make it feel special.
bouquet.likes: ribbon scraps and presents with handwritten tags.
bouquet.hates: squashed wrapping and a present with no room for a note.
bouquet.hobbies: Finding new ways to tie a bow, then giving the bow away.

bonsai.description: A tiny tree canopy accompanies an expert in taking time. This kid can consider the position of one twig for an entire afternoon.
bonsai.likes: small trays and changes too tiny to notice at first.
bonsai.hates: bulky things on a small table and rushed decisions.
bonsai.hobbies: Drawing the same little branch each day to spot what has changed.

terrarium.description: A miniature glass dome makes a fine hat for a collector of tiny worlds. Counts each patch of moss as an important landmark.
terrarium.likes: little landscapes and beads of dew on glass.
terrarium.hates: crumbs spoiling a tiny path and lids left askew.
terrarium.hobbies: Arranging miniature paths that lead to equally miniature nowhere-in-particulars.

teapot.description: The small spout band belongs to a generous host with a precise routine. Makes room for a visitor by moving everything one inch over.
teapot.likes: matching saucers and one more place at the table.
teapot.hates: stains on the tablecloth and a saucer put away still damp.
teapot.hobbies: Practising an elegant pour with an empty cup.

cookie.description: Wears a bitten biscuit cap without worrying about the missing bit. Believes every small achievement deserves a proper snack break.
cookie.likes: little rewards and tins with a snug lid.
cookie.hates: sharp tangs and a snack break cancelled halfway through.
cookie.hobbies: Keeping a tally of things finished, including finishing the tally.

pretzel.description: A looping cap tops a kid with a talent for untangling. Will patiently work through a ribbon knot, then tie a much nicer bow.
pretzel.likes: a tangy crunch and loops with room to spare.
pretzel.hates: damp ribbons and tangles hidden at the bottom of a bag.
pretzel.hobbies: Making doodles that loop back to where they began.

soup.description: Carries a little pot and ladle with the air of someone expecting company. Sets out an extra bowl even on a quiet day.
soup.likes: round bowls and a table with space for everyone.
soup.hates: things rolling off the table and empty seats at snack time.
soup.hobbies: Counting bowls, then checking whether one more will fit.

snowglobe.description: A little globe sits beside this kid's crown like a pocket-sized day out. Finds it soothing when every speck settles in its own time.
snowglobe.likes: tiny scenery and flakes drifting slowly downward.
snowglobe.hates: dusty crumbs and being jostled before things have settled.
snowglobe.hobbies: Drawing miniature scenes with more detail than the page can hold.

ice_sculptor.description: A little block of ice is this kid's latest project. Pauses after every careful chip to decide whether the shape might already be done.
ice_sculptor.likes: cool shade and edges that catch a pale glint.
ice_sculptor.hates: squishy corners and projects hurried out into the sun.
ice_sculptor.hobbies: Sketching shapes with only three lines, then trying with two.

weather_vane.description: An arrow cap accompanies a keen observer of passing breezes. Announces each change of direction, including the very brief ones.
weather_vane.likes: rustling husks and clear views in every direction.
weather_vane.hates: being stuck behind a tall fence with nothing to observe.
weather_vane.hobbies: Drawing arrows in a notebook and adding the time beside each one.

balloon.description: Keeps a little balloon close and plans very gentle outings. Stops beneath every low branch to make sure the route is roomy enough.
balloon.likes: light little snacks and open patches of sky.
balloon.hates: pointy clutter and a string snagged beneath a basket.
balloon.hobbies: Drawing round shapes that never quite manage to be circles.

steamboat.description: A funnel cap and a tiny model boat make this kid's interests quite clear. Every trip is scheduled, though departure is often after lunch.
steamboat.likes: gentle chugging rhythms and a timetable with snack breaks.
steamboat.hates: sticky model parts and a departure announced too early.
steamboat.hobbies: Making paper tickets for leisurely imaginary trips.

lifeguard.description: Carries a bright ring and keeps an orderly row of towels. Happiest when everyone has a dry spot to sit after a little paddle.
lifeguard.likes: striped towels and a shady place for a break.
lifeguard.hates: crumbs on damp towels and a rest spot with nowhere to hang things.
lifeguard.hobbies: Marking the nicest paddling spots on a very simple map.

kiln.description: A little brick arch tops a collector of handmade tiles. Knows exactly which shelf holds each one, even the tile shaped like a sock.
kiln.likes: warm earthy colours and a row of finished tiles.
kiln.hates: damp shelves and a carefully sorted stack getting muddled.
kiln.hobbies: Testing new stamped patterns on small squares of clay.

aurora.description: A soft fold of colour drapes behind this quiet stroller. Will take the long evening route just to see how the sky changes along it.
aurora.likes: dusky colours and long pauses beneath the open sky.
aurora.hates: crunching through a quiet moment and curtains closed too early.
aurora.hobbies: Keeping little swatches of every evening colour the pencils can manage.

festival.description: Bunting overhead and drum at the ready, this kid celebrates small occasions thoroughly. A newly sharpened pencil counts.
festival.likes: bright pennants and a reason to gather round.
festival.hates: spills near the drum and decorations packed away too soon.
festival.hobbies: Writing tiny celebration songs for things that happened today.

observatory.description: A little telescope helps this kid take a very big interest in the sky. The notebook has plenty of room for things not spotted yet.
observatory.likes: clear nights and a warm mug beside the notebook.
observatory.hates: crumbs on the lens and a page too crowded for another dot.
observatory.hobbies: Plotting patterns of bright dots, then inventing names for the patterns.

botanical_garden.description: A little trellis and seed tray accompany a patient note-taker. Every leaf deserves a label, though some labels need smaller writing.
botanical_garden.likes: leaf shapes and labels written in a careful hand.
botanical_garden.hates: crumbs mixed into the seed tray and tags with missing dates.
botanical_garden.hobbies: Drawing leaf outlines and trying to fit them all on one page.

moon_garden.description: A crescent cap and little shaded lamp suit this late stroller. Checks on the garden when the day's noisy visitors have gone home.
moon_garden.likes: pale paths and the soft rustle of leaves after dusk.
moon_garden.hates: loud crunches on a quiet stroll and lights left much too bright.
moon_garden.hobbies: Drawing the same garden corner by daylight and by lamplight.

patisserie.description: A tiered cake cap gives this kid lofty ideas about decorating. Adds one delicate flourish, steps back, then adds a much tinier one.
patisserie.likes: little swirls and neatly spaced dots.
patisserie.hates: muddy colours and a flourish squashed beneath its wrapper.
patisserie.hobbies: Practising fancy borders around the plainest notes in the notebook.

winter_market.description: A striped awning makes a snug roof for this tiny stallkeeper. Saves the driest corner for a visitor and remembers their usual spot.
winter_market.likes: warm bowls and neatly stacked paper bags.
winter_market.hates: sticky wrapping and a draught under the awning.
winter_market.hobbies: Making small signs, then deciding which one looks most welcoming.

harbor.description: Carries a little anchor and takes settling in seriously. Once a bag is unpacked, this kid knows it is time to sit and watch the ripples.
harbor.likes: coiled ropes and a firm place to set things down.
harbor.hates: supplies rolling away and being asked to pack up just after arriving.
harbor.hobbies: Practising tidy rope coils and giving each one a neat label.

sky_fair.description: A tiny wheel peeks overhead and a ticket sash keeps things official. This kid plans outings with an excellent view and plenty of rests.
sky_fair.likes: paper tickets and a view above the bunting.
sky_fair.hates: crumbs in ticket pockets and queues with no shady patch.
sky_fair.hobbies: Designing tickets for imaginary rides, including a very slow one.

rescue_station.description: Folded canvas and a little torch are packed for helpful outings. This kid always brings somewhere to rest, plus a spare snack bag.
rescue_station.likes: easy-to-pack snacks and a comfy place to pause.
rescue_station.hates: squashed supplies and bags with no room left for a spare.
rescue_station.hobbies: Packing a rest-stop kit and checking that the canvas folds neatly.

sculpture_park.description: A curling sculpture sits overhead like a very grand doodle. This kid pauses beside every interesting shape and gives it a little title.
sculpture_park.likes: curving shapes and a bench at just the right distance.
sculpture_park.hates: rolling display pieces and a title card that keeps falling over.
sculpture_park.hobbies: Giving pebbles elaborate titles and arranging them for a tiny exhibition.

windmill.description: Broad little sails turn above a keeper of grain sacks and gentle rhythms. Thinks a slow, steady morning is a morning well spent.
windmill.likes: grainy crusts and the soft creak of wooden sails.
windmill.hates: stained sacks and a steady rhythm interrupted halfway through.
windmill.hobbies: Counting slow turns and drawing a small mark for each one.

mosaic.description: A stepped tile cap tops a collector who keeps every little offcut. The odd-shaped piece is usually the one this kid reaches for first.
mosaic.likes: colourful patches and finding a spot for the odd little piece.
mosaic.hates: murky spills and the smallest pieces being swept away.
mosaic.hobbies: Laying out tiny patterns, then moving just one piece to see what changes.
